headline: Desired capacity is set below minimum size, so the ASG will ignore it and stay at 3 instances instead of scaling to 1.
suppressed: No context in the PR about how the overnight scaling is meant to work. If this is meant to be time-based scaling, scheduled actions should be used instead of changing desired_capacity.

findings.evidence_ref: Diff shows desired_capacity changed to 1, but min_size remains 3. AWS requires desired_capacity >= min_size and will enforce min_size.
findings.explanation: This configuration is invalid. AWS will ignore the desired_capacity of 1 and maintain 3 instances to satisfy min_size. The fleet will not scale down as intended.
